ashwin: Quick sync - i'm prototyping a proxy-side lease model to cut tails on quota checks. want rapid feedback before i write an RFC.
maria: ping eng-infra, curious about consistency and abuse tradeoffs.
sanjay: core q: let proxies do provisional admits or always central-checkout?
emily: provisional helps latency but makes global fairness tricky.
ashwin: proposal: proxies get short leases (50-200ms) they can spend locally; central is authoritative and reconciles. proxies fallback to central when empty.
taylor: amplification risk if noisy client hits many proxies. how to limit?
ashwin: plan: central enforces caps and issues leases only if aggregate smoothing windows allow. proxies send sampled usage back as "humidity" signals; central can revoke leases via ephemeral nonce.
maria: suggest a hard cross-proxy cap per-tenant plus a fast reclaim path. we should simulate amplification scenarios.
sanjay: central should keep approximate per-tenant window state and reject lease grants that would exceed it.
emily: telemetry: include lease origin, size, expiry, reason, and latency delta on fallback. reuse ingress tags.
ashwin: example events: 
lease.issued tenant=acme size=20 origin=proxy-17 reason=burst
lease.revoked tenant=acme cause=revocation-rate-limit
taylor: rollout?
ashwin: opt-in config, canary 1% proxies for 24h, then 10% if stable. auto-disable if SLO regressions or token-drift.
maria: cross-dc fairness? leases should be dc-scoped; central enforces dc budgets and a global backstop.
sanjay: consider client-binding (session id) to limit multi-proxy amplification.
emily: add decay window on refill to avoid synchronized renewals. chaos tests should revoke leases mid-flight.
taylor: i'll draft the test matrix and rollout checklist.
ashwin: i'll turn this into an RFC early next week and include a dashboard for lease churn. ack if you agree with leases + central backstop.
sanjay: ack. good plan.
emily: ack.
taylor: ack. drafting checklist.
devops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary: proxies-canary-set-5 @ 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z :rocket:
